title: bp Energy Outlook 2022 edition (outlook to 2050)
scenario_note: Three scenarios; none named central. New Momentum 'is designed to capture the broad trajectory along which the global energy system is currently progressing'.

entries.subject: electric vehicles
entries.quote: In these two scenarios, there are around 2 billion or more electric vehicles in the global vehicle parc by 2050, compared with 7 million in 2019.
entries.note: Stated for Accelerated and Net Zero together, 'around 2 billion or more'.

entries.subject: electric vehicles
entries.metric: EV share of new vehicle sales
entries.quote: The share of electric vehicles (pure battery electric vehicles and plug-in hybrids) in new vehicle sales increases from 2% in 2019 to 25-30% in 2030 and around 90% in 2050 in Accelerated and Net Zero.
entries.note: Range '25-30%' for Accelerated and Net Zero together; lower bound recorded.
